description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Raytheon develops aerospace and defense technologies and mission-critical systems that support national security and allied defense. The Software Engineer I will design, develop, test, debug, and integrate C++ software for real-time EO/IR systems running on Linux, while collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams and supporting qualification testing.
Software engineer developing and testing C++ real-time systems for aerospace electro-optical and infrared applications

Responsibilities:
• Deliverables include but not limited to:
• Design, develop, and debug software in C++ for real-time systems running on Linux platforms
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including systems engineering, electrical engineering and test, to ensure seamless integration of software
• Implement and optimize software algorithms to meet performance, reliability, and scalability requirements of mission-critical applications
• Perform integration testing hardware, ensuring seamless operation and compliance with system requirements
• Write and maintain software documentation, including design specifications, technical reports, and user manuals
• Work onsite at McKinney, TX
• Support Formal Qualification Test events
• Conduct unit testing and software integration testing to verify functionality and compliance with system requirements
• Troubleshoot and resolve software issues, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions
• Adhere to industry best practices, coding standards, and security guidelines specific to aerospace and defense applications
• Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers and ensuring adherence to program standards
• Able to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

Requirements:
• Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM)
• Experience in C++ programming and familiarity with object-oriented design principles
• Experience working with Linux operating systems, including shell scripting and command-line tools
• Experience working effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment

Preferred:
• Experience with hardware-software integration and debugging
• Understanding of pipeline implementation and utilization, including Static Code Analysis, Automated Build, and Automated Test techniques using continuous integration/continuous delivery with Test-Driven Development approach
• Ability to manage multiple priorities
• Effective verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to fly on flight test aircraft in support of system platform testing
